# Post Engineer

> Post Engineer lets AI agents schedule and auto-publish videos and images
> they made elsewhere to YouTube, Instagram, LinkedIn, Threads, Facebook Pages,
> Bluesky, Rumble and more. Personas group the publishing accounts of one
> brand or character. Post Engineer does not generate media: bring the file
> from your own tool. New accounts get a 7-day free trial for publishing.
> Post Engineer is open source under the Apache-2.0 license
> (https://github.com/Ryan-Carloso/post-engineer): self-host it on your own
> VPS or use the hosted platform.

## Platform

- [Post Engineer](https://post-engineer.com/): create an account, create
  personas, connect social accounts, schedule automated posting.
- [API keys](https://post-engineer.com/recipes): generate the API key used by
  the MCP server.
- [Prompts and recipes](https://post-engineer.com/recipes): ready-made prompts
  for the MCP server.

## HTTP API

- [OpenAPI spec](https://post-engineer.com/openapi.json): every endpoint callable
  with an API key (`Authorization: Bearer pe_live_...`).
- [API documentation](https://post-engineer.com/api-documentation.txt): auth,
  errors and the publishing flow.

## MCP server

- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/post-engineer-mcp): run locally
  with `npx -y post-engineer-mcp@latest` and `POST_ENGINEER_API_KEY`.
  Requires Node.js 20.10+.
- [MCP server docs](https://github.com/Ryan-Carloso/post-engineer/tree/main/apps/mcp):
  setup, tool list, prompts, and social account ID mapping.
- [Repository](https://github.com/Ryan-Carloso/post-engineer): the Post Engineer
  monorepo (web, engine, MCP server).

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://post-engineer.com/docs): agent guides for Post Engineer.
- [MCP server](https://post-engineer.com/docs/mcp): connect Claude and other agents with the MCP server, locally or remotely.
- [HTTP API](https://post-engineer.com/docs/api): call the HTTP API with a bearer key.
- [Use cases](https://post-engineer.com/docs/use-cases): daily videos, series and scheduled campaigns.
- [Integrations](https://post-engineer.com/docs/integrations): every network Post Engineer publishes to.
- [Help](https://post-engineer.com/help): guides for using Post Engineer, in Portuguese and English.
- [First steps](https://post-engineer.com/help/primeiros-passos): create a persona, upload a first video and publish it.
- [Connect accounts](https://post-engineer.com/help/conectar-contas): connect social accounts to publish videos to them.
- [Help in English](https://post-engineer.com/en/help): guides for using Post Engineer.
- [First steps in English](https://post-engineer.com/en/help/primeiros-passos): create a persona, upload a first video and publish it.
- [Connect accounts in English](https://post-engineer.com/en/help/conectar-contas): connect social accounts to publish videos to them.


=== BEGIN api-documentation.txt ===
Post Engineer API
================================================================================

Base URL:        https://post-engineer.com
Development URL: http://localhost:3434
OpenAPI spec:    https://post-engineer.com/openapi.json
MCP server:      npx -y post-engineer-mcp@latest (env POST_ENGINEER_API_KEY)

The OpenAPI spec lists every endpoint below. It is generated from the MCP
parity mapping (apps/mcp/src/__tests__/parity-endpoint-tools.json) by
`node apps/web/scripts/generate-openapi.mjs`, with request and response
schemas from apps/web/scripts/openapi-schemas.mjs. Some nested items (social
accounts, metrics rows) are typed as free-form objects.

================================================================================
AUTHENTICATION
================================================================================

Create an API key in the dashboard (https://post-engineer.com/recipes) or
through POST /api/api-keys (web session only). Keys start with `pe_live_`
and are shown once.

Send the key on every request, either way:

  Authorization: Bearer pe_live_xxxxxxxx
  X-API-Key: pe_live_xxxxxxxx

A key can be limited to specific personas. A missing key returns 401
"Authentication required."; an invalid key returns 401 "Invalid API key.".

================================================================================
RESPONSES AND ERRORS
================================================================================

- JSON bodies. Failures carry success:false and an error message.
- Routes return a flat { "success", ... } payload.
- 400 invalid, over-length or conflicting input (nothing is truncated or
  coerced silently). 401 bad key. 402 TRIAL_EXPIRED: the free trial ended,
  publishing and scheduling are blocked (contact the owner to extend it).
  404 unknown id. 409 conflict. 410 gone: an expired upload. 429 rate
  limited: retry with backoff. 5xx transient: retry with backoff. Each
  operation's statuses are in the spec.
- Upload, destructive and fan-out routes are rate limited per caller.

================================================================================
PUBLISHING
================================================================================

Post Engineer does not generate media. Make the video or image with your own
tool, then publish it:

1. POST /api/videos/upload-url                     create a staged upload
2. PUT the file to the returned signed URL
3. POST /api/videos/uploads/{uploadId}/complete    mark the upload complete
4. POST /api/media/publish-existing                publish now (mode "asap")
   or schedule once at publishAt (mode "scheduled", 3h to 30d ahead)

POST /api/upload-content publishes a small video directly in one multipart
request. Read the result with GET /api/schedule/slots/{slotId}.

================================================================================
ENDPOINTS (all require an API key)
================================================================================

METHOD PATH                                                   OPERATION
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
POST   /api/upload-content                                    publish video direct
POST   /api/videos/upload-url                                 create video upload
POST   /api/videos/uploads/{uploadId}/complete                complete video upload
POST   /api/videos/publish-by-id                              publish uploaded video
POST   /api/media/publish-existing                            publish or schedule existing media
GET    /api/persona/list                                      list personas
POST   /api/persona                                           create persona
PATCH  /api/persona                                           update persona
DELETE /api/persona                                           delete persona
GET    /api/persona/delete-preview                            get persona delete preview
GET    /api/persona/identity-card                             read a persona's identity card
POST   /api/persona/identity-card                             render the image prompt for a scene from the card
GET    /api/persona/publishing-accounts                       get persona publishing accounts
PUT    /api/persona/publishing-accounts                       set persona publishing accounts
GET    /api/account                                           list social accounts
GET    /api/pinterest/boards                                 list pinterest boards
DELETE /api/account                                           disconnect account
POST   /api/account/connect-url                               connect account (OAuth URL)
POST   /api/bluesky-connect                                   connect account (Bluesky)
POST   /api/threespeak-connect                                connect account (3Speak)
POST   /api/rumble-connect                                    connect account (Rumble)
POST   /api/telegram-connect                                  connect account (Telegram)
GET    /api/schedule                                          list schedules
DELETE /api/schedule                                          cancel schedule
GET    /api/schedule/status                                   list posts
GET    /api/tool-config                                       get tool configuration
PUT    /api/tool-config                                       save tool configuration
GET    /api/schedule/slots/{slotId}                           get slot
PATCH  /api/schedule/slots/{slotId}                           update slot title
DELETE /api/schedule/slots/{slotId}                           delete slot
GET    /api/posts/{id}                                        get post
GET    /api/metrics                                           get post metrics
GET    /api/metrics/last-24h                                  get views and engagement gained in the last 24 hours
GET    /api/metrics/retention-curve                           get YouTube retention curve
POST   /api/share-links                                       create public read-only share link
GET    /api/share-links                                       list share links
DELETE /api/share-links/{id}                                  revoke share link
GET    /api/experiments                                       compare prompts per account
GET    /api/prompts                                           list recipe prompts
GET    /api/prompts/{slug}                                    get recipe prompt
POST   /api/prompts                                           create prompt
PATCH  /api/prompts/{slug}                                    update prompt
DELETE /api/prompts/{slug}                                    delete prompt
GET    /api/prompts/{slug}/versions                           list old versions of your prompt
GET    /api/prompts/{slug}/versions/{version}                 read one old version in full
POST   /api/prompts/{slug}/versions/{version}/restore         restore an old version as a new one

Not in this list: session-only routes (OAuth callbacks, API key management,
logout, GET /api/health) and the public
GET /api/version.

================================================================================
SOCIAL ACCOUNTS
================================================================================

Supported: YouTube, Instagram, LinkedIn, Threads, Facebook Pages, Bluesky,
3Speak, Rumble, Telegram. Connect via POST /api/account/connect-url (returns
an https auth_url to open in a browser), POST /api/bluesky-connect (app
password), POST /api/threespeak-connect (Hive posting key), POST
/api/rumble-connect (access token issued by emailing bd@rumble.com) or POST
/api/telegram-connect (a @BotFather bot token, the chat ID or @username, and
chatType channel or group: a channel bot must be an administrator who can
post, a group bot a member allowed to send). Then map accounts to a persona
with PUT /api/persona/publishing-accounts.

================================================================================
MARKETPLACES (RapidAPI, MCP Registry)
================================================================================

The same API key works everywhere.

- RapidAPI: send your Post Engineer key in Authorization: Bearer pe_live_...
  next to the X-RapidAPI-Key header. RapidAPI forwards it; without it the API
  returns 401.
- MCP Registry: io.github.Ryan-Carloso/post-engineer (npm post-engineer-mcp),
  configured with POST_ENGINEER_API_KEY.

================================================================================
SELF-HOSTING
================================================================================

See docs/SELF_HOSTING.md in https://github.com/Ryan-Carloso/post-engineer.
=== END api-documentation.txt ===

## MCP tools

10 intent tools; each takes an `action`. Personas and accounts are given by name or id. Every tool and every action is listed below.

- `personas` — List, read, create, update and delete personas (avatar, language, niche). Writes are previewed first, then confirmed. Personas are given by name or id. Actions: `list`, `get`, `create`, `update`, `delete`.
- `persona_media` — A persona's identity card and the image prompts rendered from it, for your own image tool. Actions: `get_card`, `render_prompt`.
- `accounts` — List, connect and disconnect social accounts, read or set which accounts a persona publishes to, and list Pinterest boards. Accounts are given by name or id. Actions: `list`, `connect`, `disconnect`, `get_persona_publishing`, `set_persona_publishing`, `list_boards`.
- `schedules` — List scheduled posts, cancel a schedule, read a slot, change a slot title or delete a slot. Actions: `list`, `cancel`, `get_slot`, `update_slot_title`, `delete_slot`.
- `posts` — List published posts and read one. Actions: `list`, `get`.
- `insights` — Post metrics, the last-24-hours metrics, the YouTube retention curve, and public share links for metrics (create, list, revoke). Actions: `post_metrics`, `last_day`, `retention_curve`, `share_link_create`, `share_link_list`, `share_link_revoke`.
- `experiments` — Compare your prompts inside each publishing account: per account, each prompt version with its results. Actions: `results`.
- `publish_video` — Publish a finished video or image you made elsewhere, directly or through a staged upload, now or at a scheduled time. Actions: `from_file`, `create_upload`, `complete_upload`, `publish_upload`, `publish_existing`.
- `prompts` — The prompt library: list and read prompts, and create, update, delete and restore your own, with version history. Actions: `list`, `get`, `create`, `update`, `delete`, `versions`, `restore`.
- `tool_config` — Read and save the search tool and the licensed stock sources. Keys are stored encrypted and only their presence and last 4 characters are ever returned. Actions: `get`, `save`.
- Prompts: `/daily-news` (daily news becomes a post), `/github-prs` (GitHub PRs become posts), `/full-setup` (full setup becomes posts).
